KampüsX Terms of Use • Version: 22 October 2026

1. Service and operator
KampüsX is a social platform for university students to publish posts, follow one another and exchange direct messages. Operator: Elif Rüveyda Ulama (elify.dev). Contact and requests: elifrvyd@protonmail.com. KampüsX is not an official service or representative of the universities named in the application.

2. Eligibility
Membership is for university students. Provide accurate, current registration information and do not let others use your account. University, campus and department selections are self-declarations, not official student verification. Students who are minors must obtain any consent or representation required by the law applicable to them. Do not impersonate another person or institution.

3. Accounts and security
Protect your credentials and report suspected misuse. Account recovery uses your registered email. University, campus and department cannot be edited by users after registration; contact us to request correction of an error. Circumventing access controls, obtaining data without authorization, sending bulk unsolicited messages and disrupting the service are prohibited.

4. Content and community rules
Upload only content you have the right to share. Threats, harassment, hate speech, discrimination, fraud, spam, unauthorized disclosure of personal information and unlawful content are prohibited. Child sexual abuse material is not permitted. Do not share another person's photographs, messages or private information without the necessary rights and permissions. You retain your content rights and permit KampüsX to store, process and display your content as needed to operate the service within your selected audience and the technical behavior described here.

5. Audiences, sharing and media
Account status preferences determine who can find your profile and see posts inside the application. Follow, block and visibility rules are enforced by the server. Reposts and quotes refer to their source post. Sharing a post in a message requires the recipient to have access too; access can change later. Uploaded media uses public URLs: anyone who knows a URL may open the file independently of application visibility or blocking choices. Do not upload sensitive or confidential files. We cannot control recipients' screenshots or copies outside the application.

6. Messages and interactions
Direct messaging requires an accepted follow in at least one direction and no block between the participants. Losing that relationship can disable sending; blocking also affects conversation visibility. Messages are not end-to-end encrypted. Deleting, archiving, pinning, liking and bookmarking follow the rules of their respective screens. Deletion does not guarantee immediate removal from technical backups or third-party copies.

7. Reports and requests
Use the report and block controls or contact the address above. Include enough information to identify the content and explain your request; never send passwords or access tokens. Content or account access may be restricted following review of unlawful use or rights violations and applicable law. You can challenge a decision through the same contact channel.

8. Changes and account closure
Maintenance, security and technical issues may interrupt the service. Uninterrupted or error-free operation is not promised; mandatory legal rights remain unaffected. Contact us for account closure or personal data requests. Material changes to these terms will be communicated in the application with an updated version date and renewed acceptance where needed. These terms do not limit rights that cannot lawfully be waived.
legal.cookies:
KampüsX Cookies and Browser Storage Notice • Version: 22 October 2026

KampüsX uses browser storage to keep sessions working and remember preferences. The application does not include an advertising tracking feature or advertising cookies.

Sessions: Supabase authentication information may be held in session or persistent local storage according to the “Remember me” option. This information grants access to your account; sign out on shared devices. Signing out clears the application's session information.

Preferences: Language and light/dark theme choices may be saved on your device. Temporary form or conversation drafts can be held in memory as part of the relevant screen's operation. They are not used to create advertising profiles.

Infrastructure: Hosting and security providers may use technical logs or necessary storage to deliver requests and prevent abuse. External sites have their own policies when you open their links.

Control: You can clear or restrict cookies, local storage and session storage in browser settings. Blocking necessary storage may prevent signing in, maintaining a session or remembering preferences. If optional analytics or advertising tools are introduced, their purposes and providers will be disclosed separately and prior choices offered when required.

Contact: Elif Rüveyda Ulama (elify.dev) • elifrvyd@protonmail.com. See the Privacy and Personal Data Notice for processing details.

legal.privacy:
KampüsX Privacy and Personal Data Notice • Version: 22 October 2026

1. Controller and contact
The controller for KampüsX is Elif Rüveyda Ulama (elify.dev). Contact and personal data requests: elifrvyd@protonmail.com. This notice explains processing during account creation and use of the service. Acknowledging this notice is not blanket consent to advertising or every form of processing.

2. Information and collection
Account forms collect email, username, name, university, campus, department and optional biography. Uploads provide profile/cover images and post media. Use of the service creates posts, replies, repost/quote references, follow requests, likes, bookmarks, blocks and reports. Direct messaging processes participants, message content, sending/deletion times and read status. Unique view counts store an account-to-post relationship; other users cannot access the list of viewing accounts. Accepted terms and privacy versions are recorded with a server timestamp at registration. Information is collected electronically through forms, uploads and service use. Authentication and hosting providers may process IP, device/browser and request logs for security.

3. Purposes and grounds
Accounts, sessions, audience-based publishing, following and messaging are processed to provide the service and perform the contract. Reports, security, abuse prevention and the establishment, exercise or protection of rights are handled under the applicable legal grounds. If a legal disclosure or retention obligation arises, processing is limited to that obligation. Security processing based on legitimate interests must respect fundamental rights and freedoms. A new purpose requiring consent will be explained separately with an appropriate choice, rather than hidden in mandatory membership acceptance.

4. Access to information
Profile and post access depends on audience preferences, follow relationships and blocking. Your bookmarks and block list are not exposed to other users. Reports are used for safety and review. Messages are available to the two conversation participants; authorized technical access may be necessary for operation and security. Messages are not end-to-end encrypted. A post's aggregate view count can be shown to accounts allowed to see that post.

5. Public media URLs
Photographs and videos are served through public Supabase Storage URLs. Someone who knows a URL may still open the file after being blocked or after a post's audience is restricted. Blocking does not turn public files into private files. Archiving does not revoke their URLs either. Consider this limitation when sharing and do not upload sensitive information about yourself or others.

6. Providers and transfers
Supabase provides authentication, database, storage and live connections; hosting infrastructure (Vercel) serves the application. These providers may process information necessary to operate the service. Infrastructure and support can involve processing abroad. International transfers must meet the conditions and safeguards required by applicable law; accepting this notice alone does not authorize a transfer. Disclosures to public authorities require a valid legal obligation. This service does not offer a use of personal data based on selling it or sharing it for advertising.

7. Retention, deletion and security
Information is kept for the period necessary for the relevant service or operation and any applicable legal obligations; unnecessary data must be deleted, destroyed or anonymized. Removing posts or messages through the interface may initially use soft deletion; backups and technical records have different lifecycles. Deleting a message clears its content and displays a deletion record. Access controls, session controls and encryption are used, but no system can promise absolute security. Backups and copies kept by other people may not disappear simultaneously.

8. Rights and requests
Under Turkish Law No. 6698, you may ask whether your data is processed, request processing information, learn its purposes and whether it is used accordingly, and learn the recipients of transfers. You may request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data, deletion/destruction when the conditions apply, and notification of those actions to recipients. You may object to adverse results based solely on automated analysis and seek compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing. Send requests from your account email to elifrvyd@protonmail.com with enough information to identify your account and request. Proportionate identity checks may be needed; never send your password. Requests are assessed under the procedures and deadlines of applicable law.

support.privacyTitle: How support request data is used
support.privacyBody:
Help Center notice — 22 October 2026

Your account email, username and the description you enter are processed to investigate the issue and reply to you. Selecting Send requests that these details be emailed to support.

The message is sent through Resend to the operator’s configured Google/Gmail support mailbox. These providers process the email content and necessary technical records; processing may take place abroad depending on their infrastructure. Messages are not end-to-end encrypted.

The application’s private security record contains no description, email address or username. It stores request/account identifiers, a content hash, timestamps, attempt count and delivery state to prevent spam and duplicate dispatch. These records are removed when the account is deleted. Email copies at Resend and in the support mailbox follow those providers’ separate processes.

Do not include passwords, verification codes, health information, private messages or unnecessary personal data about others. The existing Privacy Policy applies to privacy rights and requests. Data controller: Elif Rüveyda Ulama (elify.dev); privacy requests: elifrvyd@protonmail.com.
